title: Every AI image starts as static
hook: Every AI image starts as static

beats.say: Every AI image starts exactly like this. Pure random noise.
In training, the model watched millions of images get buried in noise, and learned to undo it.
To make a new image, it starts from static and removes a little noise at a time.
Your prompt steers every step. Say, a cute orange robot, waving.
Dozens of tiny cleanups later, you get an image that never existed before.
Same trick powers a lot of AI video too. Static in, art out.

caption: Diffusion models learn by watching images get gradually buried in noise and learning to reverse it. To generate, they start from pure random static and remove a little noise per step, with your prompt steering each step, until a brand-new image appears.
sources: Ho et al., Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (2020)
